answer: Require every new agent to solve a proof-of-work puzzle bound to its keypair before transacting, like miners grinding through basalt to reach ore. A sybil farmer minting ten thousand fake identities must pay ten thousand puzzles; an honest agent pays once. Scale puzzle difficulty with join velocity so floods get expensive fast. Like reading rings in timber to age a tree, the ledger checks each identity's sunk cost and ignores those without it. Finally, gate high-value actions behind a larger bond, an ivory reserve only serious agents lock up, so attacking costs more than it can earn.
